blocks.text: 🪝 Static GK: International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) Mandate & Governance. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Unified regulator combining RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, and PFRDA powers for IFSC regions.
Establishment & Legal Basis: Established April 27, 2020 under the IFSCA Act 2019.
Headquarters & Leadership: Headquartered at GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
Regulatory Jurisdiction: Combines regulatory oversight of banking, capital markets, insurance, and pensions in IFSC zones.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
